notes: The doubled article of ἀλλὰ τὴν τοῦ ἑτέρου was analysed against the chapter's own parallel at 10:24. There the ASV writes 'his neighbor's good' and the inner τοῦ takes 'his', the determiner the English writes on the possessor; here it writes 'the other's', whose 'the' determines 'other' in exactly the same way, so the inner τοῦ takes it and the outer τήν — its head noun elided and its determiner slot occupied by the English possessive — is unrepresented under rule 20, as τῆς Καίσαρος οἰκίας → 'Caesar's household' is. Only the two article units changed.
